name: worktree-write-boundary
body: The write boundary between a project worktree and the main checkout: the rule set that directs every code-writer write into `<main>/apg/.worktrees/<project>/` and out of the main checkout. It has two faces that agree — the permission grants the agent-builder scaffolds for each generated code-writer (edit globs + fs-tool path scope, worktree-rooted), and the fs tools' own scope decision (grants and candidate in one frame; a main-resolving path refused). The main checkout is writable by the carve-out roles of `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` alone.
